Case reference: 2014002843.CaseDesc: A party of 6 men departed Churchill, Manitoba, on a fishing trip traveling in three canoes. On June 20, 1967, two of the three canoes became stranded on mud flats at a point where the Hayes and Nelson Rivers empty into the Hudson Bay. The men made camp for the night and then the following day Kurt Hild, Ronald Davidson and James Cochrane all attempted to retrieve the stranded canoes. On return to the camp the men were confronted with high winds and freezing rain which forced them out of sight. None of the remains of the men have been recovered. Foul play is not suspected in the matter.

Case reference: 2014001642.CaseDesc: In October 1983, Edna Smith was last seen at a camp with two other persons on East Trout Lake, located approximately 120 kilometres north of Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. A search operation successfully located the bodies of her two companions, but she herself remained unaccounted for. The boat that had been used by the three individuals was discovered capsized in the lake. It is suspected that all three individuals drowned.

Deformity: Mouth, Cleft Palate had been operated on

Case reference: 2007005499.CaseDesc: Lindsey Nicholls was 14 years old when she disappeared in 1993. She left the group home where she was living in the Comox Valley, BC at about 10:30 a.m. after having an argument with her foster mother. She was last seen walking away from the residence to visit some friends in Courtenay. She left all of her belongings and treasures in her room; she did not seem to be planning to run away.

Case reference: 2006025799.CaseDesc: Anthony Roberts was last seen driving his vehicle east on King Street in Prescott, Ontario, on January 8, 1996. He was reported missing on January 19, 1996, and has not been heard from or seen since that time.

Case reference: 2009000299.CaseDesc: On November 5, 1989 at approximately 5:30 pm, George Giles and a friend left George's cottage on Fox Island in Lake Simcoe enroute to a marina at Island Grove.  Weather conditions were very poor at the time and the boat eventually capsized some distance from shore, after taking on water. His friend managed to swim back to Fox Island but George was not able to make it to shore, due to the treacherous weather and water conditions. On November 20th, 1989 the boat was discovered stranded on a sandbank near Joyland Beach in Orillia. George's' body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2013000058.CaseDesc: Marie-Berthe Perreault Astle Wiseman has been missing since June 26, 1975 from Montreal, Quebec. Marie-Berthe was last seen in her home located in the suburb of Pointe-Claire in Montreal before mysteriously disappearing.

Case reference: 2014001826.CaseDesc: On November 5, 1960, Andrew Moses was last seen as he left his base camp on Brunswick Lake in Algoma County, Ontario. Andrew had left the base camp to check his trap line, which was approximately 5 miles in length near Ericson Creek. On November 13, 1960, a small search group was formed when Andrew did not return. The group located a rifle belonging to Andrew leaning against a tree. The following day, a half eaten beaver was located inside of a nearby camp on Ericson creek. The camp and trap line were searched one year later, and it revealed that it was vacant with no signs of being visited.

Case reference: 2014005302.CaseDesc: On November 11, 2005, in Toronto, Canada, Zaina Trujillo-Talib was abducted by her father, Chaudhry Talib and her paternal grandmother, Shama Talib.  Chaudhry and Shama immediately took six-year-old Zaina to their family home located in Lahore, Pakistan.  Since this time, Zaina's mother has not been allowed to have any contact with her daughter.

Case reference: 2018062802.CaseDesc: On August 27, 2000, at approximately 11:00 a.m., Yao Lin was seen for the last time at his residence in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2022048184.CaseDesc: Vatsal Rabari was last seen at a rest area in the Parc des Laurentides, in Stoneham-et-Tewkesbury, Quebec, on September 19, 2022. Vatsal was reported missing to police on September 25, 2022 when family and friends received a postdated email indicating that he was feeling despondent. Vatsal had recently resigned from his job and had previously lived in the provinces of Ontario and Nova Scotia before settling in Quebec.

Case reference: 2006012699.CaseDesc: John James Semple lived in a retirement home on Yearly Road, Huntsville, Ontario.  He was last seen in Huntsville in January 1998.

Case reference: 2020018574.CaseDesc: Steven Woytowich is believed to be homeless and was last seen in the Beverly area of Edmonton, Alberta, in early March of 2020.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, Lady on a mushroom

Case reference: 2014032019.CaseDesc: On March 21, 1963, the dismembered remains of an unidentified man were found in burlap sacks on the side of the road near Pavilion, British Columbia. He had an old injury to his spine, likely causing pain and stooped posture, and was believed to have died a few months to years before being found.

Case reference: 2014002009.CaseDesc: Leroy Marshall, AKA Roy Marshall, has been missing since July 23, 1979 from Saint John, New Brunswick. Leroy moved in with his sister on the west side of Saint John in June of 1979. Leroy had a job interview with the school district on July 23, 1979 but failed to show. Leroy previously lived in Somerville, Massachusetts, United States of America, between 1961 and 1971.

Case reference: 2014003278.CaseDesc: Janette Brunet left her home in Ottawa, Ontario on January 30 1988 and went with friends to a local pub in the Mechanicsville neighbourhood. Janette was last seen in the parking lot of Ozzie's Pub on Holland Avenue at 1:00 a.m. on January 31 1988.

Hair: Brown, Dyed, Sometimes dyes her hair

Gary was last known to be living and working in the Pink Mountain area. He was driving a 2014 black Mitsubishi Outlander.

Case reference: 2014004714.CaseDesc: In May 1975, William Lindsay was seen for the last time in Field, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, William, also known as Larry, had cashed in a federal tax refund cheque at a corner store. Prior to his disappearance in 1972, he had completed the Air Force’s basic training course (#7214) in Cornwallis, Nova Scotia, and then enrolled in the Communication Systems Tech course.

Scar: Cheek, Small crescent shaped on the left side

Case reference: 2014002675.CaseDesc: Richard Monroe was last seen on October 2nd, 2001 by the owners of Serge's Restaurant on Elgin Street in the city of Greater Sudbury. Richard is believed to have suffered from dementia. He spent most of his time in Thessalon, Sault Ste. Marie, Dunn's Valley, Sudbury and British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014001425.CaseDesc: Terry Hrynick was reported missing by the manager of Sickle Lake Lodge in Manitoba in the early hours of August 3, 1986. He had spent the previous evening and early morning with friends. According to them, Terry had been very quiet in the days leading up to his disappearance. On the night of his disappearance, he was described as intoxicated. At one point, witnesses saw him stumble out the door of the cabin. About 15 minutes later, they heard a boat but did not see him. The empty boat was located the following day. An extensive search on land and water failed to find him. There was no indication that Terry found his way to shore and he has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014005263.CaseDesc: On November 1, 2007, Annie Proulx was seen for the last time in the Rimouski area in Quebec. Annie has not been seen or heard from since.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Rose, Heart and Bulldog

Case reference: 2014005776.CaseDesc: James Turgeon was last seen on Wednesday, April 17, 2012 at approximately 3:00 p.m. traveling East on foot on Highway #16 near North Battleford, Saskatchewan. James has known mental health issues and has been diagnosed with schizophrenia. He has a history of walking away from his residence, but will usually return. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2023024770.CaseDesc: Sebastien Lagace was obliged to reside at the Domaine Orford treatment center in Sherbrooke, Quebec, in accordance with the terms of his court order. On the evening of December 23, 2022, Sebastien exited the facility on foot, carrying his backpack. Sebastien's parents reported him missing on May 19, 2023, as they had not heard from him since his voluntary departure from Domaine Orford.

Case reference: 2014002743.CaseDesc: On January 16, 1994, Yoann Crouzatier was reported missing after leaving the family residence in Laval, Quebec. Yoann has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014004809.CaseDesc: On August 7, 2006, Jeffrey Peterson was reported missing by a family member. Following a thorough investigation, it was determined that Jeffrey was last seen by a neighbour close to his residence in Manitou, Manitoba, on the afternoon of August 5, 2006.  Extensive searches were conducted in the Manitou region and its environs, but Jeffrey was not located.

Case reference: 2012020122.CaseDesc: Robert Bishara was last seen during the evening of March 17, 2009 in Brossard, Quebec. At the time of his disappearance, Robert was driving a black 2006 Chevrolet Trailblazer bearing a Quebec licence plate 941 TBA. The car has not been located. Robert originates from Egypt and no one has seen or heard from him since.

Case reference: 2013000043.CaseDesc: On September 4, 2010, Jonathan Jette and Rachael Bagnall went hiking in a mountainous region north of Pemberton, B.C. They intended to spend 2 to 3 days climbing some peaks in the area. They failed to return and were reported missing. Their vehicle was located however despite an extensive search, no other trace of them has been found.

Sweater: Wool, Brown, White, zip up sweater (Hudson's Bay type)

Case reference: 2014002762.CaseDesc: On March 3rd, 1982, Laurence Peterson and Randolph Johanson were reported missing by Mr. Johanson’s girlfriend. Mr. Johanson and Mr. Peterson were last seen on February 28th, 1982, leaving the Shelter Island Marina, on their boats. Mr. Johanson was reportedly using his 26 ft. long salvage tug boat to haul Mr. Peterson’s 43 ft. wooden halibut fishing vessel to Lund, BC. The men were reported missing when they did not arrive at their destination. Extensive searches were unsuccessful. It has been speculated that the two men disappeared to start a new life.

Case reference: 2014001102.CaseDesc: On March 4, 1973, the remains of a young adult man were recovered from the Burrard Inlet in Vancouver, British Columbia. He carried a Canada flag pocket knife and is believed to have been in the water for several months prior to the discovery.

Case reference: 2014004487.CaseDesc: On June 3, 2003, at approximately 9:00 a.m. a fisherman and his helper, Phillip McKay, left Berens River Manitoba to retrieve their commercial fishing nets from Sandy Bar Bay. Upon arrival, one of the nets got caught in the propeller of the boat motor, pulling the boat down. Shortly thereafter, 2 large waves capsized the boat and both men were thrown into the water. Both men were wearing oilers, making it difficult to swim. The fisherman survived and was treated for shock and hypothermia. The body of his helper, Phillip McKay was never located.  Phillip McKay is presumed dead due to drowning.

Deformity: Right Leg, Crooked, walks with a limp

Case reference: 2006010399.CaseDesc: William Halverson was last seen getting into a canoe at Bald Indian Bay in Lake of the Woods. He failed to arrive at his destination of Pine Portage Bay.

Case reference: 2013000050.CaseDesc: William 'Billy' Weinbender has been missing since approximately 7:30pm on May 6th, 1994 from Winnipeg. At the time he went missing he was living in an apartment building in the North End of the city. William "Billy" was last seen in the McPhillips Street and Leila Avenue area of Winnipeg.

Case reference: 2014003848.CaseDesc: On November 5, 1964, the Grand Rapids RCMP were advised that Harvey Hudson was two weeks overdue in returning from a trip to Cedar Lake from Grand Rapids, Manitoba. It was established that Harvey left The Pas on October 20th and arrived at the Cedar Lake Post.  When he reached Cedar Lake, he was told to wait for a boat from Easterville which was expected shortly. A witness said he walked to Easterville but turned back. He then took a canoe and set off for Easterville, using a piece of board as a paddle. It is believed that Harvey had little or no food, rifle or other camping supplies. Numerous land, air and water patrols were made with negative results.

Case reference: 2018059603.CaseDesc: Following new information, investigators believe Lisa MacEachern was last seen in downtown Calgary, Alberta, leaving a business in the 800 block of First Street S.W. on Wednesday, June 27, 2018. Lisa is also believed to have been staying at a residence in the 1000 block of First Street S.W. prior to her disappearance. There are no traces of Lisa's life after her last known phone contact with her family, which occurred on Tuesday, July 3, 2018. She has not been heard from since. It is uncharacteristic for Lisa's family to have no contact with her and they remain concerned for her welfare.

Case reference: 2006010299.CaseDesc: On November 11, 1970, at approximately 4:00 p.m., Edward Bucharest and his son, Barry Bucharest, were last seen by their family members in Kenora, Ontario. The pair had left from their cottage located on Kimberly Road, north shore of the Big Stone Bay in the municipality of Lake of the Woods, in a 14-foot fiberglass boat. The capsized boat, two life jackets, and other belongings were subsequently located.

Jacket: Green, Parka, with gold pile lining
Wool, Red, Black, with gold pile lining

Case reference: 2021054828.CaseDesc: On November 15, 2021, at approximately 6:30 p.m., Berhanei Peynado was seen for the last time in the area of Table Rock in Niagara Falls, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Berhanei was despondent.

Case reference: 2014005757.CaseDesc: Harley Boxall was seen leaving his residence in Nanaimo on March 9, 2012. A suicide note was located in his room suggesting he was going to drown himself. However, within weeks of being reported missing, there were unconfirmed reports of Mr. Boxall within the city of Nanaimo or that he may be residing with the homeless community in Vancouver’s lower-Eastside.

Case reference: 2021048330.CaseDesc: On July 12, 2015, at approximately 7 :00 a.m., Dan Ingram was seen for the last time as he slipped and fell into the water near the Whirlpool State Park in Niagara Falls, New York.

Case reference: 2019012891.CaseDesc: Dean Brett Todd was last seen by his brother, around Easter time in 2000, near First Memorial Services Kamloops (formerly Schoening Funeral Home) on Tranquille Road in Kamloops, British Columbia. Case reference: 2012020129.CaseDesc: Nadine Lussier and Dominic Gauthier worked at a convenience store in Sainte-Sophie, Quebec. They were seen for the last time on June 16, 2004. They left the convenience store around 3:00 p.m., and were then seen in a Prévost, Quebec area restaurant. Nadine's vehicle had not moved from the restaurant between the evening of June 16, 2004 and the time Dominic Gauthier's mother reported their disappearance on June 18, 2004.

Case reference: 2019015560.CaseDesc: On March 26, 2019, Donna Paré was reported missing in Montreal, Quebec. Donna last communicated with her family in December 2018, and is known to live a transient lifestyle. She is known to frequent the Berri-UQAM and Place-des-Arts metro stations, and the McDonald’s on Sainte-Catherine Street East and Berri Park in Montreal, Quebec. Donna’s family has reason to fear for her health and safety.

Case reference: 2014006219.CaseDesc: On the night of the 17 to 18 August 2013, Benoit Germain was seen for the last time while he was attending a truck show in Baie-du-Febvre, Quebec. His car was found abandoned a few days later on a trail to a wooded area north of La Tuque, Quebec. Benoit has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005313.CaseDesc: On September 24, 2007, Azelea Brown last spoke to her mother who was overseas.

Case reference: 2012020095.CaseDesc: On February 21, 2006, between 8:00 and 8:30 am Draper Jim was dropped off on the road by the Health Center on the Saulteaux First Nation (North of Cochin, Saskatchewan). Draper was attempting to return home to the Witchekan First Nation and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014006137.CaseDesc: On January 2, 2012, Spencer Joly was last seen in Vernon BC. Spencer told a number of people he was travelling to the Kelowna Airport and eventually flying to Phuket Thailand. Spencer was seen later that same day being dropped off by Taxi in Predator Ridge, a new housing development in Vernon. There was no record of Spencer ever leaving the country or arriving in Thailand.

Case reference: 2014005682.CaseDesc: On September 27, 2011, Bernard Wierzba was seen for the last time as he swam with a friend near the Manola Bridge in Barrhead County, Alberta. During this time, Bernard was not wearing a life jacket and he has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014002126.CaseDesc: On March 18, 1997, Mark Bird was seen for the last time when he left his home in Welland, Ontario. His abandoned vehicle was later found in Niagara Falls. At the time of his disappearance, Mark was despondent and he has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2013000125.CaseDesc: Bonnie Joan Thomas (born Cooper) of Rollingdam, outside of St. Stephen, New Brunswick, met some friends and went across the U.S.A. border to the Legion in Calais, Maine. They went to a St. Patrick's Day dance and after the evening's celebrations, Bonnie left the Legion alone in her 1973 red Volvo station wagon. Bonnie drove back through the Calais/St. Stephen border crossing into Canada. At the Canadian entry point, Bonnie hit the customs booth causing minor damage to her car and was last seen talking to the Customs Officer. The following morning Bonnie's husband realized she was missing, and called the police. On March 18, 1978, Bonnie's car was found abandoned near St. Stephen on a logging road near the St Croix River.

Case reference: 2017074237.CaseDesc: On November 17, 1999, the partial remains of an adult male were discovered in a wooded area off of Tower Road, south of the Town of Mactier, in Severn Township, Ontario.

Case reference: 2008007599.CaseDesc: On September 10, 1978, Hugh Bain and three others participated in the Oshawa Clipper Race, which took place from Oshawa, Ontario to Olcott, New York and back to Oshawa. Hugh was assigned to operate the 24-foot vessel. A large wave hit the vessel, breaking over it. The movement of the vessel and the subsequent wave breaking over the boat caused him to fall into Lake Ontario.  He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2021052226.CaseDesc: On January 28, 2016, at approximately 1:45 p.m., Daniel Leslie was last seen at Terrapin Point, on the American side of Niagara Falls, in Niagara Falls State Park, New York. During the time of his disappearance, Daniel was despondent.

Case reference: 2016044292.CaseDesc: Chenel Dubé was last seen on August 10, 1970 in Montreal, Quebec. That evening, he called his mother to tell her that he would be home later. Chenel's vehicle was found 3 days later in the parking lot of a restaurant in Ville Saint-Laurent, Quebec.

Case reference: 2015036270.CaseDesc: Brian Franko was last seen on July 10, 2015, walking away from the Saskatchewan Hospital in North Battleford.  He did not appear to be in a good frame of mind, and his demeanour suggested that he was feeling despondent.  Brian was walking towards the South Saskatchewan River when he was last seen.  Extensive searches were conducted, but unfortunately these were unsuccessful.

Case reference: 2014004353.CaseDesc: George Turnbull was last seen in Makinak, Manitoba, on June 22, 2002, at approximately 8 p.m., as reported by a home care worker. He was last spoken to on the phone by his son at around 10 pm that same day. Searches of the area around his residence and farmyard was initiated by his family and volunteers. George suffers from mild dementia and has previously wandered off.

Case reference: 2014003608.CaseDesc: Brianne Wolgram was last seen on the evening of September 5, 1998, in Revelstoke, British Columbia.  Ms. Wolgram had plans to socialize with friends that evening but did not attend.  Ms. Wolgram's vehicle was located on September 10, 1998 on the Alkolkolex Forest Service Road near Revelstoke.

Case reference: 2014004162.CaseDesc: On October 16, 1987, Charles Eddy was seen for the last time when he left his residence in Moncton, New Brunswick, where he lived with his brother. Charles suffered from partial schizophrenia, was known to be heavy smoker and carry large sums of money.

Case reference: 2014004610.CaseDesc: On June 7, 1967, Absolom Halkett and his colleague, James Brady, were dropped off by plane at Foster Lake, SK, which is located 120 miles north west of La Ronge, SK. Case reference: 2014003657.CaseDesc: Gerald Whitehead was reported missing by his sister in Halifax, Nova Scotia on February 7, 1982. Gerald went missing from a Halifax rooming house.

Case reference: 2014006086.CaseDesc: Martin Geoffrion was last seen on April 26, 2013 in Montreal, Quebec. Martin left his home in the neighbourhood of Mercier-Est, around 4:00 p.m. in a Mercedes vehicle. On April 30, 2013, the vehicle was located in a cul-de-sac in Saint-Roch-de-l'Achigan, Quebec. According to his relatives, Martin was not suicidal.

Case reference: 2014003981.CaseDesc: On September 15, 1978, Wayne Kevin Spark was last seen in Richmond, British Columbia. Wayne left home to attend Vancouver Community College but never showed up. Wayne has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2023064985.CaseDesc: Leslie Boyd was reported missing to police on November 16, 2023, from Fredericton, New Brunswick, a few days after having missed a court date. Case reference: 2006021599.CaseDesc: Zbigniew Gajda left Thunder Bay on his snowmobile to go ice fishing on Lake Superior.  He was last seen on January 4, 2001 around Caribou Island Point.  It is thought that his snowmobile may have gone through the ice.

Jacket: Black, Purple and blue on arms

Case reference: 2014001139.CaseDesc: On August 4, 1974, the skeletal remains of a teenage boy were discovered under a log near Lost Lagoon in Stanley Park, Vancouver, British Columbia. He was believed to have died at least a year before his discovery.

Pants: Corduroy, Dark Blue, Button fly pants
Sweater: Synthetic, Dark Blue, Turtleneck, Knitted turtleneck sweater

Case reference: 2014004563.CaseDesc: Brian Nadeau and David Pushor were last seen on November 25, 2004 travelling together in a 1983 Honda Civic near Fort Assiniboine, Alberta. The vehicle was later recovered from the Athabasca river where Highway 661 crosses via an ice bridge in the winter. Brian and David were not located.

Tattoo: Right Forearm, Text "Love is kind, 69er, Devil"

Case reference: 2022006217.CaseDesc: On February 14, 2022, Jessie Morrissey's mother reported him missing from Amherst, Nova Scotia.  Jessie was last seen travelling in a dark-coloured Jeep Patriot in the Springhill area on the morning of February 13. The Jeep Patriot he was travelling in was located on snowmobile Trail 104 in Leamington, Nova Scotia later that evening.

Case reference: 2008009698.CaseDesc: Richard Rusholme was last seen when he left his residence.  He was preparing to leave with a friend to look for work out West and had already packed his bags. He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014001142.CaseDesc: On June 21, 2003, a body was found in the forest near Lake L'Anse à l'Eau in Tadoussac, Quebec, within the boundaries of the Saguenay Fjord National Park (Sépaq). Investigators believe the skeletal remains had been there since October 2001 or 2002.

Teeth: Gold Visible, Stainless steel crown on the teeth

Case reference: 2011005799.CaseDesc: On June 20, 2011 Ibrahim Sendagire was driving on Highway 17 between Terrace Bay and Marathon, Ontario.  He was involved in a motor vehicle accident and fled the scene into the bush area. Police searches of the area yielded negative results. Ibrahim has not been located and has had no contact with family or friends. Last Seen: Highway 17, Tuuri Township.  Approximately 4 km west of the Steel River bridge near Black Fox Lake.  This area is essentially located between the towns of Marathon and Terrace Bay, in Northwestern Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004744.CaseDesc: Cyril Detimmerman and a friend left Brandon, Manitoba, on April 10, 1976 on the Assiniboine River to travel to Treherne. Cyril was experienced in navigating the river, but the water levels were very high due to spring flooding. The pair soon encountered strong currents and large amounts of debris in the river. While attempting to navigate to shore, the boat capsized, sending both men into the water. Both men were wearing life jackets. Extensive searches were conducted by land, air, water and dragging operations for several miles along the river, all with negative results. Cyril was never found and is presumed dead from drowning.

Case reference: 2014030665.CaseDesc: On January 19, 1978, the partial remains of a female believed to be aged between 55-70 years of age, were found in the waters of the Salish Sea, southwest of Victoria, British Columbia. She had moderate arthritis and significant healed injuries to her left ankle and foot. It is believed she was deceased several months or even years before her remains were recovered

Case reference: 2014006241.CaseDesc: On September 7, 2013, at around 10 am, Ranjit Singh was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Ranjit had travelled from India to visit Toronto and was due to return home on a flight scheduled for 5 pm, but he never boarded the plane.

Case reference: 2014001801.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1992, Marshall Holmes wandered into the woods near Vassar in Manitoba. He is described as a recluse and a hermit. He had previously gone missing and returned of his own accord. He enjoyed being in the wilderness and liked to sleep in the long grass. The last time he went missing, he was gone for three days and emerged from the woods when he became hungry. Extensive searches were conducted by land, air and with the assistance of a police dog.

Jacket: Nylon, Blue, White, Has 3 vertical stripes

Case reference: 2006021899.CaseDesc: Deqian Rang was last seen on April 20, 1992 in the Village of Elora, Ontario. At the time of her disappearance Deqian and her husband operated the 'Abacus Restaurant', south of Elora. An extensive police investigation has failed to locate her.  Police suspect foul play in her disappearance.

Case reference: 1986087920.CaseDesc: On July 30, 1985, Nicole Morin was seen for the last time leaving her apartment in Toronto, Ontario. Nicole had made arrangements to meet her friend in the lobby of their building so they could go swimming in the pool located at the rear of the building. Nicole never appeared in the lobby. Despite an intense search at the time, Nicole has not been found.

Mark: Forehead, Small birthmark on upper right side of forehead

Case reference: 2014002649.CaseDesc: On October 17, 1978, Garry Allen and a friend were fishing on Turtle Lake near Glaslyn, Saskatchewan. Witnesses state the weather changed and the water got very rough. On October 20th, they were reported missing. A swamped canoe and the body of the friend was located, however, searches failed to locate Garry.

Case reference: 2013000061.CaseDesc: Amanda Bartlett was residing in Winnipeg, Manitoba, in 1996, having previously resided in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, and The Pas. The last sighting was in late July 1996, when a family member reported her to have been seen near the intersection of Selkirk Ave. and Salter St. We have not had any contact from Amanda since that time.

Case reference: 2021050310.CaseDesc: In the afternoon of October 13, 2021, Cody Harper was seen for the last time as he left his residence in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Cody has not been seen or heard from since this time.

Case reference: 2006012199.CaseDesc: Leonel Phillips left Butterfield Lodge by boat to travel on Lake Matinenda (Blind River, Ontario) to Log Chateau. Leonel's boat was located adrift but he was never found. He is presumed to have drowned.

Scar: Chest, A burn scar below his right breast
